descriptions.text: Enchanted Nipple Ring of the Superior Fire Demon's Hand Maiden. This may only be equipped on a quadruped. This may only be equipped on a female. Warning: Unless you're planning on getting a lot of weird and unnecessary surgery, you ain't equipping this. All nipple rings must be manually affixed the first time they are equipped. Oh boy. Let me tell you about Superior fire demons. These bitches are crazy. Worse than the minor demons. I know, I know. That sounds chauvinistic and rude. You can't get away with saying shit like that anymore. Here's the thing. These bitches are godsdamned crazy. Full stop. …

beats.headline: From the Beguiler's box
beats.text: Carl laughs when Donut's Beguiler's box opens on a single shining nipple ring that glows red. This is not funny, Carl, she says. When she pulls it out, she calls it the most sexist description she has ever read. It may only be equipped on a female quadruped, and superior fire demons, the AI explains, are so crazy they must be chaperoned by hellspawn familiars, who use rings like this one. Worn, it allows the removal of cursed items, makes her impervious to natural fire and lava and resistant to fire spells, keeps her from losing health inside Sheol, and adds Intelligence per cent to every fire attack.

beats.headline: Bitch, What?
beats.text: Carl wants it on her right away. Mordecai agrees, but wants to talk about the spell first. Bitch, What? is a berserking spell, once every thirty hours: for twenty seconds Donut catches fire, is invulnerable to blunt damage, gets really angry and kills every goddamn thing in the room. Mordecai has seen it; the rage elemental lived in that state, and it is really called Fire Berserker. She is to cast it only when she is by herself. Her three fire spells, Fireball, Magic Missile and Wall of Fire, will all be much more intense. It is good, he says, but still not as good as her spellbook; and when Donut complains that she got no celestial box, he tells her the ring is practically a celestial.

beats.headline: Wall of Fire, bigger
beats.text: As the ghommids come out of the fog, Anton's crossbow makes little monkey noises each time he fires and Sister Ines lobs her white balls one after another. Donut casts Wall of Fire, and it crackles bigger than ever thanks to her new nipple ring. A pair of clockwork Mongos appear and tear through the mobs, and Carl tosses two infused smoke curtains.

beats.headline: Better than Carl's
beats.text: The Iowa area is about to crash to the ground, with maybe an hour to loot it. The cards and a lumpy leather bag hover in the middle of the burned trailer, still too hot to reach. Donut actually has better fire protection than Carl, thanks to her nipple ring, but they are both exhausted and do not want to risk it. They wait for the fire in the yard to calm.
